about: Speech the memory receives as recordings: a call summary, a stand-up, a note. Spoken by the macOS system voices (Samantha, Daniel, Milena, Luciana) and encoded to 32 kbit/s mono mp3 by the shipped ffmpeg. `keys` lists what memory must keep; each key is a list of accepted spellings (a number may come back as digits or words).

items.text: The client call moved to Thursday at two pm. Diego will send the contract draft tonight. The budget is capped at forty eight thousand dollars this quarter.
Yesterday I fixed the ledger sync timeout. Today I am deploying version three point twelve to production. No blockers.
Созвон с клиентом перенесли на среду. Иван отправит договор вечером. Бюджет на квартал триста тысяч рублей.
Пароль от вайфая в офисе сменили. Новая сеть называется офис пять джи. Ответственный Пётр Сидоров.
A reunião com o fornecedor ficou para sexta-feira. Beto vai levar a proposta revisada. O orçamento máximo é de sessenta mil reais.
O voo para Lisboa sai às sete e quarenta e cinco. O portão é o B vinte e dois.
